questions.title: Find the smallest number in an array
questions.statement:
Given an array arr[]. The task is to find the smallest element and return it.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [5, 10, 3, 8, 1] → Output: 1
- Input: arr[] = [10, 10, 10] → Output: 10
- Input: arr[] = [7] → Output: 7
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the smallest element in the array.

questions.title: Largest in Array
questions.statement:
Given an array arr[]. The task is to find the largest element and return it.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [1, 8, 7, 56, 90] → Output: 90
- Input: arr[] = [5, 5, 5, 5] → Output: 5
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the largest element in the array.

questions.title: Second Smallest and Second Largest
questions.statement:
Given an array arr[] of integers, find the second smallest and second largest elements in the array.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [12, 35, 1, 10, 34, 1] → Output: [10, 34]
- Input: arr[] = [5, 5, 5] → Output: [-1, -1]
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return two space-separated integers (second smallest and second largest), or -1 if they don't exist.

questions.title: Reverse a given array
questions.statement:
You are given an array of integers arr[]. You have to reverse the given array.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr = [1, 4, 3, 2, 6, 5] → Output: [5, 6, 2, 3, 4, 1]
- Input: arr = [1] → Output: [1]
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the reversed array as space-separated integers.

questions.title: Count Elements With Maximum Frequency
questions.statement:
You are given an array nums consisting of positive integers. Return the total frequencies of elements in nums such that those elements all have the maximum frequency.

**Examples:**
- Input: nums = [1,2,2,3,1,4] → Output: 4
- Input: nums = [1,2,3,4,5] → Output: 5
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated positive integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return a single integer representing the total count of elements with maximum frequency.

questions.title: Half Ascending and Half Descending Sort
questions.statement:
Given an array arr of even size, sort the first half of the array in ascending order and the second half in descending order.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [10, 20, 30, 40] → Output: [10, 20, 40, 30]
- Input: arr[] = [5, 4, 6, 2, 3, 8, 9, 7] → Output: [2, 4, 5, 6, 9, 8, 7, 3]
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of even array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the sorted array as space-separated integers.
questions.constraints:
2 ≤ N ≤ 10^5 and N is even
-10^9 ≤ arr[i] ≤ 10^9

questions.title: Sum of Array
questions.statement:
Given an array of integers arr[], find the sum of its elements.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [1, 2, 3] → Output: 6
- Input: arr[] = [15, 12, 13, 10] → Output: 50
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the sum of all elements in the array.

questions.title: Rotate Array
questions.statement:
Given an integer array nums, rotate the array to the right by k steps, where k is non-negative.

**Examples:**
- Input: nums = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7], k = 3 → Output: [5,6,7,1,2,3,4]
- Input: nums = [-1,-100,3,99], k = 2 → Output: [3,99,-1,-100]
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers, third line contains k.
questions.outputFormat: Return the rotated array as space-separated integers.

questions.title: Mean or Average of an Array
questions.statement:
Given an array arr[], return the floor value of the mean of its elements.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [1, 3, 4, 2, 6, 5, 8, 7] → Output: 4
- Input: arr[] = [4, 4, 4, 4, 4] → Output: 4
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the floor value of the mean as a single integer.

questions.title: Median of an Array
questions.statement:
Given an array arr[] of integers, calculate the median.

**Examples:**
- Input: arr[] = [90, 100, 78, 89, 67] → Output: 89
- Input: arr[] = [56, 67, 30, 79] → Output: 61.5
questions.inputFormat: First line contains N (size of array), second line contains N space-separated integers.
questions.outputFormat: Return the median as a decimal number.
